diagnostic_cohorts.OPPOSITE_SIDE: model side differs from no-vig market side
diagnostic_cohorts.SAME_SIDE_CONFIDENCE_DISAGREEMENT: model side equals no-vig market side within Stage 2; the >15pp signed selected-side gap is the confidence disagreement

gap: Signed positive selected-side probability gap; no absolute value. Strict > 0.15 (15 percentage points).
missing: Unavailable gap is retained and separately identifiable; it is not treated as exceeding threshold.
name: RESEARCH_EXCLUDE_EXTREME_MODEL_MARKET_GAP
no_vig_market: Convert both side median American prices to raw implied probabilities, normalize each by their two-side sum, then select probability for the model-selected side.
rule: Among Stage 1 survivors, exclude only when selected_side_model_probability - selected_side_no_vig_market_probability > 0.15.
